page.title: NAFLD Fibrosis Score
page.subtitle: Estimate advanced fibrosis risk in NAFLD using the standard published equation and local-only calculation.

overview.title: What this tool does
overview.description: This calculator reproduces the standard NAFLD Fibrosis Score workflow for clinical reference inside the Utilivo WebView runtime.

points.formula: Calculates the NAFLD Fibrosis Score and AST/ALT ratio automatically.
points.risk: Classifies results into low likelihood, indeterminate probability, or high likelihood of advanced fibrosis.
points.context: Use the output alongside clinical context, not as a standalone diagnosis.

section.title: Inputs
section.description: Enter all required values. The score recalculates live once the form is valid.

errors.integer: Age must be a whole number.
errors.range: Age must be between 18 and 120 years.
BMI must be between 10 and 100 kg/m2.

diabetes.label: Impaired fasting glucose or diabetes
diabetes.help: Select yes if either impaired fasting glucose or diabetes is present.

errors.range: AST must be between 0.1 and 2000 U/L.

alt.label: ALT
alt.help: Alanine aminotransferase. Must be greater than zero.

errors.nonzero: ALT must be greater than zero.
errors.range: ALT must be between 0.1 and 2000 U/L.

platelets.label: Platelet count
platelets.help: Enter the platelet count in x10^9/L.

errors.number: Platelet count must be a number.
errors.range: Platelet count must be between 1 and 1000 x10^9/L.
Albumin must be between 0.5 and 6.5 g/dL.

section.title: Result
section.description: Rounded to three decimals with the standard NAFLD Fibrosis Score threshold interpretation.

empty.body: Complete the form with valid values to calculate the NAFLD Fibrosis Score.

interpretations.low: The score falls below the lower threshold. This supports a lower likelihood of advanced fibrosis, but interpretation still depends on the full clinical picture.
interpretations.indeterminate: The score falls within the indeterminate zone. Correlate with the broader clinical assessment and consider additional evaluation when appropriate.
interpretations.high: The score exceeds the upper threshold. This supports a higher likelihood of advanced fibrosis and should be interpreted alongside the rest of the patient assessment.

status.empty: Enter all required values to calculate.
status.incomplete: Complete or correct the highlighted fields to enable calculation.
status.ready: All required fields are valid. The result is updating live.

how.title: How it works
how.description: The score combines age, BMI, impaired fasting glucose or diabetes status, AST/ALT ratio, platelet count, and albumin.
how.formula: NFS = -1.675 + (0.037 x age) + (0.094 x BMI) + (1.13 x impaired fasting glucose or diabetes) + (0.99 x AST/ALT ratio) - (0.013 x platelet count) - (0.66 x albumin)

diabetes.label: Impaired fasting glucose or diabetes
diabetes.value: Use 1 for yes and 0 for no.

ratio.label: AST/ALT ratio
ratio.value: AST divided by ALT. The tool blocks ALT zero values.

items.stratification: This tool supports fibrosis risk stratification in NAFLD.
items.context: Interpret the score in clinical context with the rest of the history, examination, and supporting data.
items.diagnosis: This calculator is not a standalone diagnosis.
